segments.en: I work in a bank, what about you?
Oh my god, I work in Jana Small Finance Bank.
Work is not over yet, it's done for me. Is yours done?
I am on leave today, what about you?
What to tell? How is work going? Life, everything?
Okay, is your family married or are you?
I am married, that's why I asked.
Why are you asking? You are still young.
My hometown is in the Andhra side, I am an area manager here.
No, I have rented a room. I used to work there from my hometown, then I got transferred here with a promotion.
What else is good for bankers?
Yes, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, three days off.
Same for me, I am going to my hometown tomorrow.
How many days has it been since you started using this?
I came yesterday, I was alone in Bangalore, felt bored, so I came.
I have been in Bangalore for a month now.
Actually, it's a new place, right?
It will be fine, don't worry. Bangalore is very good, everyone adjusts here.
How long have you been here?
I have been in Bangalore for three years.
What did you do for the weekend?
It should be, I have to make it myself.
No, you know, in Bangalore PGs, there are mostly Andhra PGs, so the food will be adjusted to that.
Andhra, Andhra means it's not Andhra, it's on the Karnataka border.
It's near Kolar, near Kuppam, Kolar side.
When I first came to Bangalore, I was near Kolar, there is an iPhone manufacturing company in Narasapura, right?
It was Wistron then, now it's Tata.
Okay, how many days did you work there?
No, I worked there for 10 months. It was very difficult, there were no leaves, couldn't even go to other places.
I got stuck there, then I left and came to Bangalore, stayed for a week in a different place.
Oh, gold loan, okay. Is it cash or sales?
Sales, sales. I used to do operations before, they put a lot of pressure, so I have to do sales and operations.
That's why I jumped to sales. I have been here for six months now.
Yes, I am doing sales now.
Incentives come, but it's hard. I do gold loans.
Gold loan, it depends on the location. Koramangala, right?
Very few people take gold loans.
Family misses, what to do? Have to do it for work.
Have you gone home since you came?
Have you gone home since you came to Bangalore?
No, I will go. I have a car, I will go whenever I get time. I don't go by train, it gets too late.
It's nearby, you can go and come back. K.R. Puram, right? If it was on this side, it would be a bit difficult.
You can go from there, no problem.
When are you going home? Tomorrow?
No, tomorrow, tomorrow there is no leave. I will take a half-day permission and go.
Okay, go. Saturday, Sunday, Monday, are you coming on Monday?
Monday is a festival in our village, Panchami is on that day, so I won't come on Monday.
Tuesday or Wednesday, I have to come. I need leave, it's been a month, I haven't gone home.
I am missing it, I need leave.
Here, on weekends, where do you go? What do you do? Do you have friends?
There is no one like that. I used to go every 15 days, but this last month, there were activities, so I couldn't go during the leave time.
I wasn't well either, so I didn't go. Second Saturday, fourth Saturday, I usually go home.
This time, I didn't go anywhere. I was just in the PG, went to the office, or stayed in the room.
It's like, if you go to the office, you have to go somewhere. In the morning, they take an hour to get ready.
Gold loan, our team takes it. The branch manager takes it. Our branch banking is done.
This side, they also take it. Our gold team also takes it. Target is not there, but complete target is not asked, poor people, they are good.
They don't just bring and keep it. They have to trust us. In our branch, they don't understand how they play, you know?
Today is a holiday, I don't know anything, today is a holiday, they say. When I say that, I just get up and come.
Where can I bring it from? You tell me.
For that, they say, okay, I will do it, they say. Follow-up is there, you know? It's the worst of the worst.
They say they will come here, one hour is enough, right? If you go to any bank, any industry, they finish it in 20-30 minutes. Maximum one hour, assume that.

They ask here, I will come, okay, like this, like that, they say. I have been following up for a week, a month. Madam, I will come today, or tomorrow morning, I will come, madam, I have an emergency, like this, like that, they say.

If you call, they don't respond. After a few days, you will know, no madam, there is less interest, and people who know are different, we haven't paid interest, so gold won't be auctioned, yours is not in our hands, madam, like this, like that, they say.
What to say? They don't listen, they don't ask, I will come, I will come, they say, and at the last minute, they back out.
It's hard, gold loan. It's not that good, but what to do? Activation is done, no one listens. They give a gap to breathe, that's it.
If it's something else, if we go to clarity, we have to do all the products.
You, I mean, in which one do you work? Which department?
For that customer, I have to follow up.
Oh, here, our supervisor is there. They do it like this, you know? I mean, the other branch manager.
They are in collection, the branch head.
They sometimes, I mean, starting, their branch training was done, they were fresh, right?
I am a little bit of a small girl, so they talk nicely.
They call me and give me a number, I will give it to you.
